main.description: Begin teardown of the named cluster. Sets the deletion timestamp; the finalizer then runs the gate, which passes only when the tenant path is observed shut inside the timeout. MUST NOT block: the gate is asynchronous and the two outcomes are TeardownBlocked (an alert, and nothing is destroyed) or deletion. So this call answers 202 and reports Draining, and a caller that wants the outcome polls listClusters. This is the only entry point into teardown, and it is not reversible - a Draining cluster cannot be un-drained. It is also the one verb that destroys the retained store; use controlPlaneDown to stop the control plane without losing it.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account.

phase.description: Always Draining. TeardownBlocked is deliberately not reported here - it is a condition on the cluster, observable through listClusters, not a failure of this call: nothing has been destroyed and an operator has something to act on.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.
